environment.postgres: not used by WP5.1 API contract tests

claims.behavior_proved: Shared login/change-password request schemas reject unknown fields and enforce the approved Unicode code-point bounds. The real API entrypoint launches from the tested process, serves health liveness and remains unready until route composition, dependency checks and public origin are present. Contract/API tests prove invalid profiles fail closed, malformed and oversized payloads return stable errors, unsafe requests require Origin and a successful CSRF verifier, unexpected details are not disclosed, and application logs omit unique credential/password canaries.
claims.path_proved: The real apps/api/src/main.ts process was started by the API suite and its live and readiness endpoints were exercised over a TCP listener. The complete API suite passed 21 tests; V4 workspace typecheck, architecture, toolchain and Phase 1 contract validation passed. The implementation is the shared schema/server-composition foundation specified by REM-WP5.1.
claims.configuration_proved: Node v26.7.0 and npm v12.2.0. Runtime profile validation covers test/development/staging/production profile tuples before the listener opens. WP5.1 API contract tests do not connect to PostgreSQL or claim persisted authentication behavior.
coverage_limitations: The shipped entrypoint remains unready until downstream authentication/command routes and readiness dependencies are composed; this record does not claim authentication readiness.
Persisted credentials, sessions, CSRF token storage, forced-change authorization and shared-store throttling are not claimed here; they belong to REM-WP5.2/REM-WP5.3.
No browser login journey or Phase 1 authentication BDD path is claimed.

reviewer: Implementation self-review; acceptance evidence was executed locally on the candidate.
